text: I had a great experience at Dental Care Center. The clinic is clean and welcoming, with a calm atmosphere. The staff are professional, polite, and explain everything clearly. The dentist is very skilled and works with care, making sure you feel comfortable at every step. Prices are fair and the service feels very reliable. Appointments run on time, and the overall experience is smooth and stress free. I can highly recommend this place to anyone looking for quality dental care in Pattaya.

I like this Dental clinic. I first went there in November of 2023 after much research on Dentists in the area. Everyone agreed they did good work and that their prices were reasonable.

I saw Dr Monthirada Leekpai for a cleaning and assessment. I knew the assessment was necessary since I had not seen a dentist for over 8 years.
The cleaning was fast and efficient, No issues and no pain. The cost of the cleaning was 700 THB. I needed to get 2 crowns and 2 fillings.

On my second appointment it took 1 hour to prep the teeth for 2 crowns and finish 1 filling. Total cost was 18,000. I elected to go for the ceramic crowns at 9000 THB each. The porcelain crowns were only 5000 THB each.

I did ask about the gap in my front teeth, I have had various dentists attempt to fix the gap by attaching tooth material there.
Dr. Monthirada told me that it would probably not work well and that I did not need it.

I find this to be admirable, instead of trying to sell me another fix, she was honest about the outcome.

One week later I was back to have the crowns installed and the second filling - which turned out to be fixing a chipped tooth. I do not really remember what I paid for this visit. Maybe 500 to 700 THB.

Now - fast forward to June 2025 and while chewing a toffee one of my crowns popped off. Luckily I was able to save it.

I called the dentist on Monday morning and was told to come in at 3 pm. I arrived early and was seated by 3 pm. Dr Monthirada arrived shortly after and asked me how many days ago did the crown pop off. I saidf 3 days.

She immediately got to work putting the corwn back into place. Making sure my bite was still good with the re-installed crown. It took about 1/2 hour. She told me I should get my teeth cleaned, but that was it.

I went back to reception to pay for having the crown re-attached. Shortly thereafter the assistant came out to tell me that there was no charge to re-attach the corwn.

I was very surprised.
I have had nothing but good experiences at Dental Care Center. I definitely recommend them for professional service and reasonable prices.

Before, when I had dental work done in China, it was incredibly painful; my body trembled the first time I sat down. But this dentist is amazing; the entire treatment process was virtually painless for several months, with only one or two painful episodes that subsided after medication.
